description: This file implements the TelemetryMetricsImplementation class, including methods for recording and publishing telemetry metrics, JSON parsing, and record management within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: TelemetryMetricsImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for recording and publishing telemetry metrics, managing internal metrics records, and interfacing with the telemetry system.

methods.name: generateRecordId
methods.description: Generates a unique record ID by concatenating id and markerName.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Parses a JSON string of metrics, validates, and merges it into internal records.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Filters, merges, and publishes telemetry metrics, then clears the published records.
